title: Baked Ricotta Pasta
summary: Rigatoni in a garlicky tomato sauce, baked under ricotta, Parmesan and lemon zest.

steps.text: Cook the rigatoni in a large pan of salted boiling water for {timer:10}, then drain.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a frying pan and fry the garlic for {timer:1}. Add the tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for {timer:10-12}.
Stir the pasta into the sauce and tip it into a baking dish.
Mix the ricotta with half of the Parmesan and the lemon zest. Spoon it over the pasta and scatter the rest of the Parmesan on top.
Bake for {timer:15}, until golden. Scatter with the basil to serve.

tips: The tomato sauce can be made a day ahead and kept in the fridge.
